name: CashControl Day Book
report_script:
filters = filters or {}
view = filters.get("view") or "Statement"
acct = filters.get("account")
date = filters.get("date") or frappe.utils.nowdate()

cols_statement = [
    {"label": "Particulars", "fieldname": "particulars", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 320},
    {"label": "Count", "fieldname": "count", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 70},
    {"label": "Cash In", "fieldname": "cash_in", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 125},
    {"label": "Cash Out", "fieldname": "cash_out", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 125},
    {"label": "Credit", "fieldname": "credit", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 125},
    {"label": "Ref Type", "fieldname": "ref_type", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 115},
    {"label": "Reference", "fieldname": "reference", "fieldtype": "Dynamic Link", "options": "ref_type", "width": 170},
]
cols_detail = [
    {"label": "Entered At", "fieldname": "entered_at", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 155},
    {"label": "Type", "fieldname": "voucher_type", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 115},
    {"label": "Voucher", "fieldname": "voucher_no", "fieldtype": "Dynamic Link", "options": "voucher_type", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Category", "fieldname": "category", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Cash In", "fieldname": "cash_in", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Cash Out", "fieldname": "cash_out", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Balance", "fieldname": "balance", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Remarks", "fieldname": "row_remarks", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 320},
]
cols_credit = [
    {"label": "Invoice", "fieldname": "invoice", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Invoice", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Customer", "fieldname": "customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 200},
    {"label": "POS Profile", "fieldname": "pos_profile", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Billed", "fieldname": "billed", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Cash Collected", "fieldname": "collected", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Outstanding", "fieldname": "outstanding", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
]

cols = cols_statement
rows = []
message = ""

if acct:
    comp = frappe.db.get_value("Account", acct, "company")

    cuvs = frappe.get_all("Cash Update Voucher",
        filters={"cash_account": acct, "posting_date": date, "docstatus": 1},
        fields=["name", "journal_entry", "counted_total", "book_balance",
                "difference", "variance_type"], order_by="creation")
    cuv_by_je = {}
    for c in cuvs:
        if c.journal_entry:
            cuv_by_je[c.journal_entry] = c.name

    gl = frappe.db.sql(
        "select posting_date, creation, voucher_type, voucher_no, debit, credit, remarks from `tabGL Entry` where account = %s and company = %s and is_cancelled = 0 and posting_date = %s order by creation",
        (acct, comp, date), as_dict=1)

    bfq = frappe.db.sql(
        "select ifnull(sum(debit)-sum(credit),0) from `tabGL Entry` where account = %s and company = %s and is_cancelled = 0 and posting_date < %s",
        (acct, comp, date))
    bf = frappe.utils.flt(bfq[0][0], 2)

    je_all = []
    for g in gl:
        if g.voucher_type == "Journal Entry" and g.voucher_no not in cuv_by_je:
            if g.voucher_no not in je_all:
                je_all.append(g.voucher_no)
    transfer_jes = {}
    if je_all:
        legs = frappe.db.sql(
            "select jea.parent as je, a.name as acc, a.account_type as atype, a.parent_account as pacc from `tabJournal Entry Account` jea join `tabAccount` a on a.name = jea.account where jea.parent in %s",
            (tuple(je_all),), as_dict=1)
        for l in legs:
            if l.acc != acct and (l.atype in ("Cash", "Bank") or l.pacc in ("Cash In Hand - VAC", "Cash-in-hand - VAC")):
                transfer_jes[l.je] = 1

    sums = {"Cash Sale": 0.0, "Customer Receipt": 0.0, "Other Cash In": 0.0,
            "Expense": 0.0, "Sale Return": 0.0, "Party Payment": 0.0,
            "Other Cash Out": 0.0, "Tally Adjustment": 0.0,
            "Transfer In": 0.0, "Transfer Out": 0.0}
    children = {"Cash Sale": [], "Customer Receipt": [], "Other Cash In": [],
                "Expense": [], "Sale Return": [], "Party Payment": [],
                "Other Cash Out": [], "Transfer In": [], "Transfer Out": []}
    detail = []
    bal = bf
    for g in gl:
        d = frappe.utils.flt(g.debit)
        c = frappe.utils.flt(g.credit)
        if g.voucher_no in cuv_by_je:
            cat = "Tally Adjustment"
        elif g.voucher_type == "Sales Invoice":
            cat = "Cash Sale" if d > 0 else "Sale Return"
        elif g.voucher_type == "Payment Entry":
            cat = "Customer Receipt" if d > 0 else "Party Payment"
        elif g.voucher_type == "Journal Entry" and g.voucher_no in transfer_jes:
            cat = "Transfer In" if d > 0 else "Transfer Out"
        elif g.voucher_type == "Journal Entry":
            cat = "Other Cash In" if d > 0 else "Expense"
        else:
            cat = "Other Cash In" if d > 0 else "Other Cash Out"
        if cat == "Tally Adjustment":
            sums[cat] = sums[cat] + d - c
        else:
            sums[cat] = sums[cat] + (d if d > 0 else c)
        if cat in children:
            children[cat].append({"voucher_no": g.voucher_no,
                                  "voucher_type": g.voucher_type,
                                  "amount": d if d > 0 else c,
                                  "remarks": g.remarks or ""})
        bal = frappe.utils.flt(bal + d - c, 2)
        detail.append({"entered_at": g.creation, "voucher_type": g.voucher_type,
                       "voucher_no": g.voucher_no, "category": cat,
                       "cash_in": d, "cash_out": c, "balance": bal,
                       "row_remarks": g.remarks})

    si_names = []
    for chd in children["Cash Sale"]:
        si_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    for chd in children["Sale Return"]:
        si_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    si_cust = {}
    if si_names:
        res = frappe.db.sql("select name, customer from `tabSales Invoice` where name in %s",
                            (tuple(si_names),), as_dict=1)
        for x in res:
            si_cust[x.name] = x.customer

    pe_names = []
    for chd in children["Customer Receipt"]:
        pe_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    for chd in children["Party Payment"]:
        pe_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    pe_party = {}
    if pe_names:
        res = frappe.db.sql("select name, party from `tabPayment Entry` where name in %s",
                            (tuple(pe_names),), as_dict=1)
        for x in res:
            pe_party[x.name] = x.party

    je_names = []
    for chd in children["Expense"]:
        if chd["voucher_type"] == "Journal Entry":
            je_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    for chd in children["Other Cash In"]:
        if chd["voucher_type"] == "Journal Entry":
            je_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    for chd in children["Other Cash Out"]:
        if chd["voucher_type"] == "Journal Entry":
            je_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    for chd in children["Transfer In"]:
        je_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    for chd in children["Transfer Out"]:
        je_names.append(chd["voucher_no"])
    je_remark = {}
    if je_names:
        res = frappe.db.sql("select name, user_remark from `tabJournal Entry` where name in %s",
                            (tuple(je_names),), as_dict=1)
        for x in res:
            je_remark[x.name] = x.user_remark or ""

    prof_rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "select pm.parent as prof, mpa.default_account as acc from `tabPOS Payment Method` pm join `tabMode of Payment Account` mpa on mpa.parent = pm.mode_of_payment where pm.`default` = 1 and pm.parenttype = 'POS Profile' and mpa.company = %s",
        (comp,), as_dict=1)
    my_profiles = []
    for pr in prof_rows:
        if pr.acc == acct:
            my_profiles.append(pr.prof)

    sis = frappe.db.sql(
        "select name, customer, pos_profile, base_grand_total, base_rounded_total, paid_amount, outstanding_amount from `tabSales Invoice` where company = %s and docstatus = 1 and posting_date = %s and outstanding_amount > 0.005 order by creation",
        (comp, date), as_dict=1)
    credit_mine = []
    credit_unattributed = []
    for s in sis:
        if s.pos_profile and s.pos_profile in my_profiles:
            credit_mine.append(s)
        elif not s.pos_profile:
            credit_unattributed.append(s)

    message = "CashControl Day Book | %s | %s | brought forward %s | closing %s" % (
        acct, date, bf, bal)

    if view == "Voucher Detail":
        cols = cols_detail
        rows = detail
    elif view == "Credit & Partial":
        cols = cols_credit
        for s in credit_mine:
            rows.append({"invoice": s.name, "customer": s.customer,
                         "pos_profile": s.pos_profile,
                         "billed": frappe.utils.flt(s.base_rounded_total) or frappe.utils.flt(s.base_grand_total),
                         "collected": frappe.utils.flt(s.paid_amount),
                         "outstanding": frappe.utils.flt(s.outstanding_amount)})
        for s in credit_unattributed:
            rows.append({"invoice": s.name, "customer": s.customer,
                         "pos_profile": "(none)",
                         "billed": frappe.utils.flt(s.base_rounded_total) or frappe.utils.flt(s.base_grand_total),
                         "collected": frappe.utils.flt(s.paid_amount),
                         "outstanding": frappe.utils.flt(s.outstanding_amount)})
    else:
        cols = cols_statement

        si_info = {}
        order = []
        if my_profiles:
            csis = frappe.db.sql(
                "select name, customer, outstanding_amount from `tabSales Invoice` where company = %s and docstatus = 1 and posting_date = %s and pos_profile in %s order by creation",
                (comp, date, tuple(my_profiles)), as_dict=1)
            for s in csis:
                si_info[s.name] = {"customer": s.customer, "cash": 0.0,
                                   "credit": frappe.utils.flt(s.outstanding_amount),
                                   "modes": {}}
                order.append(s.name)
        for chd in children["Cash Sale"]:
            v = chd["voucher_no"]
            if v not in si_info:
                si_info[v] = {"customer": si_cust.get(v) or v, "cash": 0.0,
                              "credit": 0.0, "modes": {}}
                oq = frappe.db.sql(
                    "select customer, outstanding_amount from `tabSales Invoice` where name = %s",
                    (v,), as_dict=1)
                if oq:
                    si_info[v]["customer"] = oq[0].customer
                    si_info[v]["credit"] = frappe.utils.flt(oq[0].outstanding_amount)
                order.append(v)
            info = si_info[v]
            info["cash"] = info["cash"] + chd["amount"]

        if order:
            prs = frappe.db.sql(
                "select sip.parent as parent, sip.account as account, sip.amount as amount, sip.mode_of_payment as mop, a.account_type as atype from `tabSales Invoice Payment` sip join `tabAccount` a on a.name = sip.account where sip.parenttype = %s and sip.parent in %s",
                ("Sales Invoice", tuple(order)), as_dict=1)
            for prow in prs:
                amt = frappe.utils.flt(prow.amount)
                if amt <= 0:
                    continue
                if prow.account == acct:
                    continue
                if prow.atype == "Receivable":
                    continue
                info = si_info[prow.parent]
                modes = info["modes"]
                key = prow.mop or prow.account
                modes[key] = frappe.utils.flt(modes.get(key)) + amt

        mode_names = []
        for v in order:
            for k in si_info[v]["modes"]:
                if k not in mode_names:
                    mode_names.append(k)
        mode_names = sorted(mode_names)
        mode_fields = {}
        cols = []
        for cdef in cols_statement:
            cols.append(cdef)
            if cdef["fieldname"] == "cash_out":
                for k in mode_names:
                    f = "mop_" + k.lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")
                    mode_fields[k] = f
                    cols.append({"label": k, "fieldname": f,
                                 "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 110})

        t_cash = 0.0
        t_credit = 0.0
        t_modes = {}
        for v in order:
            info = si_info[v]
            t_cash = t_cash + info["cash"]
            t_credit = t_credit + info["credit"]
            for k in info["modes"]:
                t_modes[k] = frappe.utils.flt(t_modes.get(k)) + info["modes"][k]

        rows.append({"particulars": "Brought forward (book, start of day)",
                     "cash_in": bf, "indent": 0, "bold_row": 1})
        sales_row = {"particulars": "+ Sales (bills at this counter)", "count": len(order),
                     "cash_in": t_cash, "credit": t_credit, "indent": 0}
        for k in t_modes:
            sales_row[mode_fields[k]] = t_modes[k]
        rows.append(sales_row)
        for v in order:
            info = si_info[v]
            child = {"particulars": info["customer"], "cash_in": info["cash"],
                     "credit": info["credit"], "ref_type": "Sales Invoice",
                     "reference": v, "indent": 1}
            for k in info["modes"]:
                child[mode_fields[k]] = info["modes"][k]
            rows.append(child)
        rows.append({"particulars": "+ Customer receipts (old dues)",
                     "count": len(children["Customer Receipt"]),
                     "cash_in": sums["Customer Receipt"], "indent": 0})
        for chd in children["Customer Receipt"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": pe_party.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"],
                         "cash_in": chd["amount"], "ref_type": "Payment Entry",
                         "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if sums["Transfer In"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": "+ Transfers in (float received)",
                         "count": len(children["Transfer In"]),
                         "cash_in": sums["Transfer In"], "indent": 0})
            for chd in children["Transfer In"]:
                rows.append({"particulars": (chd["remarks"] or je_remark.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"]).splitlines()[0][:70],
                             "cash_in": chd["amount"], "ref_type": "Journal Entry",
                             "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if sums["Other Cash In"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": "+ Other cash in",
                         "count": len(children["Other Cash In"]),
                         "cash_in": sums["Other Cash In"], "indent": 0})
            for chd in children["Other Cash In"]:
                rows.append({"particulars": (chd["remarks"] or je_remark.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"]).splitlines()[0][:70],
                             "cash_in": chd["amount"], "ref_type": chd["voucher_type"],
                             "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        rows.append({"particulars": "- Expenses", "count": len(children["Expense"]),
                     "cash_out": sums["Expense"], "indent": 0})
        for chd in children["Expense"]:
            lbl = chd["remarks"] or je_remark.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"]
            pos = lbl.find("expense (")
            if pos >= 0:
                lbl = lbl[pos + 8:]
            rows.append({"particulars": lbl.splitlines()[0][:70], "cash_out": chd["amount"],
                         "ref_type": chd["voucher_type"],
                         "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if sums["Party Payment"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": "- Party payments",
                         "count": len(children["Party Payment"]),
                         "cash_out": sums["Party Payment"], "indent": 0})
            for chd in children["Party Payment"]:
                rows.append({"particulars": pe_party.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"],
                             "cash_out": chd["amount"], "ref_type": "Payment Entry",
                             "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if sums["Transfer Out"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": "- Transfers out (handover / deposit)",
                         "count": len(children["Transfer Out"]),
                         "cash_out": sums["Transfer Out"], "indent": 0})
            for chd in children["Transfer Out"]:
                rows.append({"particulars": (chd["remarks"] or je_remark.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"]).splitlines()[0][:70],
                             "cash_out": chd["amount"], "ref_type": "Journal Entry",
                             "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if sums["Sale Return"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": "- Sale returns / refunds",
                         "count": len(children["Sale Return"]),
                         "cash_out": sums["Sale Return"], "indent": 0})
            for chd in children["Sale Return"]:
                rows.append({"particulars": si_cust.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"],
                             "cash_out": chd["amount"], "ref_type": "Sales Invoice",
                             "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if sums["Other Cash Out"]:
            rows.append({"particulars": "- Other cash out",
                         "count": len(children["Other Cash Out"]),
                         "cash_out": sums["Other Cash Out"], "indent": 0})
            for chd in children["Other Cash Out"]:
                rows.append({"particulars": (chd["remarks"] or je_remark.get(chd["voucher_no"]) or chd["voucher_no"]).splitlines()[0][:70],
                             "cash_out": chd["amount"], "ref_type": chd["voucher_type"],
                             "reference": chd["voucher_no"], "indent": 1})
        if cuvs:
            tally = sums["Tally Adjustment"]
            rows.append({"particulars": "Tally adjustments (Cash Update Vouchers)",
                         "count": len(cuvs),
                         "cash_in": tally if tally > 0 else 0,
                         "cash_out": -tally if tally < 0 else 0,
                         "indent": 0})
            for c in cuvs:
                diff = frappe.utils.flt(c.difference)
                lbl = "counted %s vs book %s (%s)" % (
                    frappe.utils.flt(c.counted_total), frappe.utils.flt(c.book_balance),
                    c.variance_type or "Balanced")
                rows.append({"particulars": lbl,
                             "cash_in": diff if diff > 0 else 0,
                             "cash_out": -diff if diff < 0 else 0,
                             "ref_type": "Cash Update Voucher", "reference": c.name,
                             "indent": 1})
        rows.append({"particulars": "= Closing drawer balance (book, end of day)",
                     "cash_in": bal, "indent": 0, "bold_row": 1})
        un_total = 0.0
        for s in credit_unattributed:
            un_total = un_total + frappe.utils.flt(s.outstanding_amount)
        if credit_unattributed:
            rows.append({"particulars": "UNATTRIBUTED CREDIT (billed without POS profile)",
                         "count": len(credit_unattributed), "credit": un_total,
                         "indent": 0, "bold_row": 1})
            for s in credit_unattributed:
                rows.append({"particulars": "Credit: %s" % s.customer,
                             "credit": frappe.utils.flt(s.outstanding_amount),
                             "ref_type": "Sales Invoice", "reference": s.name,
                             "indent": 1})

data = [cols, rows, message, None, None, 1]

name: LedgerLift Follow-ups
report_script:
f = filters or {}
view = f.get("view") or "Detail"
conds = {"parenttype": "LedgerLift Tracker"}
if f.get("from_date") and f.get("to_date"):
    conds["follow_up_date"] = ["between", [f.get("from_date"), f.get("to_date")]]
elif f.get("from_date"):
    conds["follow_up_date"] = [">=", f.get("from_date")]
elif f.get("to_date"):
    conds["follow_up_date"] = ["<=", f.get("to_date")]
if f.get("outcome"):
    conds["outcome"] = f.get("outcome")
if f.get("logged_by"):
    conds["logged_by"] = f.get("logged_by")

rows = frappe.get_all("LedgerLift Follow-up",
    filters=conds,
    fields=["follow_up_date", "outcome", "promised_amount", "promised_date",
            "next_follow_up_date", "logged_by", "notes", "parent"],
    order_by="follow_up_date desc, creation desc",
    limit_page_length=0)

parent_names = list(set([r.parent for r in rows]))
parents = {}
if parent_names:
    for d in frappe.get_all("LedgerLift Tracker",
            filters={"name": ["in", parent_names]},
            fields=["name", "customer", "outstanding_amount", "recovery_status",
                    "next_follow_up_date", "promised_amount", "promised_payment_date",
                    "last_contact_date"],
            limit_page_length=0):
        parents[d.name] = d

if f.get("customer"):
    rows = [r for r in rows if parents.get(r.parent) and parents[r.parent].customer == f.get("customer")]

if view == "By Customer":
    seen = {}
    counts = {}
    for r in rows:
        counts[r.parent] = counts.get(r.parent, 0) + 1
        if r.parent not in seen:
            seen[r.parent] = r
    result = []
    for pname, last in seen.items():
        p = parents.get(pname)
        if not p:
            continue
        result.append([p.customer, p.outstanding_amount, p.recovery_status,
                       last.follow_up_date, last.outcome, p.promised_amount,
                       p.promised_payment_date, p.next_follow_up_date,
                       counts.get(pname, 0), pname])
    result.sort(key=lambda x: (x[7] or "9999-12-31"))
    columns = [
        {"label": "Customer", "fieldname": "customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 190},
        {"label": "Outstanding", "fieldname": "outstanding_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 110},
        {"label": "Status", "fieldname": "recovery_status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 125},
        {"label": "Last Contact", "fieldname": "last_contact", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Last Outcome", "fieldname": "last_outcome", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130},
        {"label": "Promised", "fieldname": "promised_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Promised Date", "fieldname": "promised_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Next Follow-up", "fieldname": "next_follow_up", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 105},
        {"label": "Logs", "fieldname": "log_count", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 55},
        {"label": "Record", "fieldname": "record", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "LedgerLift Tracker", "width": 130},
    ]
else:
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        p = parents.get(r.parent)
        result.append([r.follow_up_date, p.customer if p else None, r.outcome,
                       r.promised_amount, r.promised_date, r.next_follow_up_date,
                       r.logged_by, r.notes, r.parent])
    columns = [
        {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "follow_up_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 95},
        {"label": "Customer", "fieldname": "customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 180},
        {"label": "Outcome", "fieldname": "outcome", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
        {"label": "Promised", "fieldname": "promised_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 105},
        {"label": "Promised Date", "fieldname": "promised_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 105},
        {"label": "Next Follow-up", "fieldname": "next_follow_up_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
        {"label": "Logged By", "fieldname": "logged_by", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "User", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Notes", "fieldname": "notes", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 300},
        {"label": "Record", "fieldname": "record", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "LedgerLift Tracker", "width": 130},
    ]
data = columns, result

name: LedgerLift Customer Ledger Summary
LedgerLift Status Breakdown

report_script:
filters = filters or {}
view = filters.get("view") or "Item Register"
grpf = filters.get("item_group")

def sp_cfg(field, dflt):
    v = frappe.utils.flt(frappe.db.get_single_value("StockPilot Settings", field))
    if v > 0:
        return v
    return dflt

def sp_pct(v):
    r = frappe.utils.flt(v, 1)
    i = int(r)
    if r == i:
        return str(i)
    return str(r)

# per-dimension cutoffs from StockPilot Settings (fallback = the original

def sp_fam(code, tn, cf, gr):
    if tn:
        return ["TN::" + tn, tn]
    if cf:
        return ["CF::" + cf, cf]
    if gr:
        return ["GR::" + gr, gr]
    return ["IT::" + code, code]

# cumulative-value classification, Excel convention (row-own cum <= cutoff;
# the crossing entity tips into the next class); ca/cb are fractions from
# the per-dimension StockPilot Settings pairs
def classify(keys, valmap, ca, cb):
    pairs = []
    tot = 0.0
    for k in keys:
        v = frappe.utils.flt(valmap.get(k))
        if v > 0:
            pairs.append([0.0 - v, k])
            tot = tot + v
    pairs = sorted(pairs)
    out = {}
    cum = 0.0
    for pr in pairs:
        v = 0.0 - pr[0]
        cum = cum + v
        share = cum / tot if tot > 0 else 1.0
        if share <= ca:
            out[pr[1]] = "A"
        elif share <= cb:
            out[pr[1]] = "B"
        else:
            out[pr[1]] = "C"
    return out

# seasonality: shares of calendar months in 24-mo demand VALUE.
# X steady (top-3 months < xa), Y seasonal (xa-xb), Z spike (> xb).
def xyz_calc(mo, mn, xa, xb):
    tot = 0.0
    for k in mo:
        tot = tot + mo[k]
    if tot <= 0.0005:
        return ["-", "", 0.0]
    pairs = []
    for k in mo:
        pairs.append([0.0 - mo[k], k])
    pairs = sorted(pairs)
    t3 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < len(pairs) and i < 3:
        t3 = t3 + (0.0 - pairs[i][0])
        i = i + 1
    t3s = t3 / tot
    if t3s < xa:
        x = "X"
    elif t3s <= xb:
        x = "Y"
    else:
        x = "Z"
    peaks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(pairs) and i < 3:
        share = (0.0 - pairs[i][0]) / tot
        if share >= 0.10:
            peaks.append(mn[pairs[i][1] - 1])
        i = i + 1
    return [x, ", ".join(peaks), frappe.utils.flt(t3s * 100, 0)]

else:

# share it). Every on-hand and demand query must scope to VAC or it double-counts
# Krushiyog Plant stock and intercompany sales (review 2026-07-25, C4/H10).
COMPANY = "Vijay Agro Centre"

today = frappe.utils.nowdate()

def sp_pack(nm):
    up = (nm or "").upper()
    toks = up.split()
    units = {"KG": "KG", "GM": "GM", "G": "GM", "ML": "ML", "L": "L",
             "LTR": "L", "LITRE": "L", "LIT": "L"}
    best = ""
    i = 0
    n = len(toks)
    while i < n:
        t = toks[i]
        num = ""
        j = 0
        while j < len(t) and t[j] in "0123456789.":
            num = num + t[j]
            j = j + 1
        rest = t[j:]
        if num:
            if rest and rest in units:
                best = num + " " + units[rest]
            elif rest == "" and i + 1 < n and toks[i + 1] in units:
                best = num + " " + units[toks[i + 1]]
        i = i + 1
    return best

def sp_fam(code, tn, cf, gr):
    if tn:
        return ["TN::" + tn, tn]
    if cf:
        return ["CF::" + cf, cf]
    if gr:
        return ["GR::" + gr, gr]
    return ["IT::" + code, code]

itemq = ("select i.name as code, i.item_name as iname, i.item_group as igrp, "
         "i.stock_uom as uom, "
         "ifnull(i.pd_pesticide_technical_name, '') as tn, "
         "ifnull(i.pd_seed_crop_family, '') as cf, "
         "ifnull(i.pd_fertilizer_grade, '') as gr "
         "from `tabItem` i where i.is_stock_item = 1 and i.disabled = 0")
if grpf:
    items = frappe.db.sql(itemq + " and i.item_group = %s", (grpf,), as_dict=1)
else:
    items = frappe.db.sql(itemq, as_dict=1)

bins = frappe.db.sql(
    "select b.item_code as code, sum(b.actual_qty) as q from `tabBin` b "
    "join `tabWarehouse` w on w.name = b.warehouse "
    "where w.company = %s group by b.item_code", (COMPANY,), as_dict=1)
onh = {}
for b in bins:
    onh[b.code] = frappe.utils.flt(b.q)

d365 = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -365)
s12 = frappe.db.sql(
    "select sii.item_code as code, sum(sii.stock_qty) as q, sum(sii.amount) as a "
    "from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii "
    "join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent "
    "where si.docstatus = 1 and si.company = %s and si.posting_date >= %s "

    v12[s.code] = frappe.utils.flt(s.a)

w1e = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -320)

    " from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii "

    "group by t.code", (COMPANY, w1s, w1e, w2s, w2e), as_dict=1)

rec = frappe.db.sql(
    "select sii.item_code as code, sum(sii.stock_qty) as q "
    "from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii "
    "join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent "
    "where si.docstatus = 1 and si.company = %s and si.posting_date >= %s "
    "group by sii.item_code", (COMPANY, r60), as_dict=1)
recq = {}
for r in rec:

def sp_cfg(field, dflt):
    v = frappe.utils.flt(frappe.db.get_single_value("StockPilot Settings", field))
    if v > 0:
        return v
    return dflt

DAYS = 122.0

Z = {"90": 1.28, "95": 1.65, "97.5": 1.96, "99": 2.33}.get(SL, 1.65)

# member records with pack-size base factors, grouped by FAMILY (whole
# molecule/grade across pack sizes - user ruling 2026-07-10; seeds stay
# per-item since they carry no family key)

for it in items:
    imap[it.code] = it
    ks = sp_fam(it.code, it.tn, it.cf, it.gr)
    fam = ks[0]
    if fam not in fams:
        fams[fam] = {"base": ks[1], "members": [], "v12": 0.0, "sups": {}}
    f = fams[fam]
    f["members"].append({"code": it.code, "pack": sp_pack(it.iname or it.code),
                         "uom": it.uom or "Nos"})
    f["v12"] = f["v12"] + frappe.utils.flt(v12.get(it.code))

famof = {}
for k in fams:
    for m in fams[k]["members"]:
        famof[m["code"]] = k
isup = {}
for r in sup12:
    fk = famof.get(r.code)
    if fk:
        d = fams[fk]["sups"]
        d[r.sup] = frappe.utils.flt(d.get(r.sup)) + frappe.utils.flt(r.q)
    lst = isup.get(r.code)
    if lst is None:
        lst = []
        isup[r.code] = lst
    lst.append([0.0 - frappe.utils.flt(r.q), r.sup])

# units (user rulings 2026-07-24): quantities are plain stock-UOM counts -
# the Unit column shows each item's own UOM from the Item master, nothing
# invented. Pack size (from the item name) appears only in Suggested Order
# when every member shares one size. All aggregation is stock-UOM counts.
for k in fams:
    f = fams[k]
    pset = {}
    for m in f["members"]:
        pset[m["pack"] or ""] = 1
    if len(pset) == 1 and "" not in pset:
        f["pack_size"] = f["members"][0]["pack"]
    else:
        f["pack_size"] = ""
    on = 0.0
    ssum = 0.0
    ssq = 0.0
    qq12 = 0.0
    rsum = 0.0
    top = None
    topq = -1.0
    for m in f["members"]:
        on = on + frappe.utils.flt(onh.get(m["code"]))
        ssum = ssum + frappe.utils.flt(wsum.get(m["code"]))
        ssq = ssq + frappe.utils.flt(wsq.get(m["code"]))
        qq12 = qq12 + frappe.utils.flt(q12.get(m["code"]))
        rsum = rsum + frappe.utils.flt(recq.get(m["code"]))
        mq = frappe.utils.flt(q12.get(m["code"]))
        if mq > topq:
            topq = mq
            top = m
    f["on"] = on
    f["q12"] = qq12
    f["s"] = ssum
    f["sq"] = ssq
    f["rec"] = rsum

             "LTR": "L", "LITRE": "L", "LIT": "L"}

    while i < n:
        t = toks[i]

    return best

# Day-Schedule due check with catch-up: [due, missed_days_ago]. A missed
# item stays listed for `grace` days until a Stock Reco touches it. Catch-up
# needs a prior count on record (lcd) - never-counted items just follow the
# rotation, else a cold-start site would flood day one.
def due_info(rec, d, freqmap, grace, lcd):
    dd = frappe.utils.date_diff(d, rec["first"])
    if dd < 0:
        return [0, 0]
    f = freqmap[rec["cc"]]
    rem = dd % f
    if rem == 0:
        return [1, 0]
    if grace > 0 and rem <= grace and lcd:
        lastdue = frappe.utils.add_days(d, 0 - rem)
        if frappe.utils.date_diff(lastdue, lcd) > 0:
            return [1, rem]
    return [0, 0]

def next_due(rec, d, freqmap):
    dd = frappe.utils.date_diff(d, rec["first"])
    if dd <= 0:
        return rec["first"]
    f = freqmap[rec["cc"]]
    rem = dd % f
    if rem == 0:
        return d
    return frappe.utils.add_days(d, f - rem)

        # family siblings ride along at level 2 (swap-proof counting, same

            rec = recs[c]

            rw["freq"] = FREQ[rec["cc"]]

    message = ("7-day schedule from %s | family siblings indented under each "

               "the counter") % focal
else:

    overdue = {}
    for c in recs:

        if di[0]:

    due = sorted(due)
    duecodes = {}

    for pr in due:

        rec = recs[c]
        rw = item_row(c, rec, imap, onh, onv, lastc)
        rw["cdesc"] = DESC[rec["cc"]]

        rw["freq"] = FREQ[rec["cc"]]

        sibs = poolmembers.get(poolof.get(c)) or []
        for sc in sibs:
            if sc == c or sc in duecodes:

            srec = recs.get(sc)
            if not srec:
                continue
            srw = item_row(sc, srec, imap, onh, onv, lastc)
            srw["cdesc"] = "family - count together"
            srw["indent"] = 1
            rows.append(srw)
    if FRZ:
        fnote = "classes FROZEN %s" % frozen_on
    else:
        fnote = "classes live"
    message = ("%d items due on %s: %d scheduled + %d overdue catch-up "
               "(grace %d d) | %d in the NEGATIVE-STOCK priority lane | "
               "family siblings listed for swap-proof counting | fill "
               "Counted, post ONE Stock Reconciliation | anchor %s, %s") % (
        len(due), focal, len(due) - len(overdue), len(overdue), GRACE,
        len(byclass.get("NEG") or []), anchor, fnote)

report_script:
filters = filters or {}
fd = filters.get("from_date") or frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -90)
td = filters.get("to_date") or frappe.utils.nowdate()
itf = filters.get("item")

def sp_fam(code, tn, cf, gr):
    if tn:
        return "TN::" + tn
    if cf:
        return "CF::" + cf
    if gr:
        return "GR::" + gr
    return "IT::" + code

conds = "sr.docstatus = 1 and sr.posting_date between %s and %s"
vals = [fd, td]
if itf:
    conds = conds + " and sri.item_code = %s"
    vals.append(itf)
rows0 = frappe.db.sql(
    "select sr.name as srn, sr.posting_date as pd, sri.item_code as code, "
    "ifnull(sri.current_qty, 0) as bq, ifnull(sri.qty, 0) as cq, "
    "ifnull(sri.current_valuation_rate, ifnull(sri.valuation_rate, 0)) as rate "
    "from `tabStock Reconciliation Item` sri "
    "join `tabStock Reconciliation` sr on sr.name = sri.parent "
    "where " + conds + " order by sr.posting_date desc, sr.name",
    tuple(vals), as_dict=1)

codes = {}
for r in rows0:
    codes[r.code] = 1
imap = {}
if codes:
    irows = frappe.db.sql(
        "select name as code, item_name as iname, "
        "ifnull(pd_pesticide_technical_name, '') as tn, "
        "ifnull(pd_seed_crop_family, '') as cf, "
        "ifnull(pd_fertilizer_grade, '') as gr "
        "from `tabItem` where name in %s", (tuple(codes),), as_dict=1)
    for ir in irows:
        imap[ir.code] = ir

groups = {}
order = []
for r in rows0:
    info = imap.get(r.code)
    tn = ""
    cf = ""
    gr = ""
    iname = r.code
    if info:
        tn = info.tn
        cf = info.cf
        gr = info.gr
        if info.iname:
            iname = info.iname
    fam = sp_fam(r.code, tn, cf, gr)
    gk = r.srn + "||" + fam
    if gk not in groups:
        base = tn or cf or gr or iname
        groups[gk] = {"srn": r.srn, "pd": r.pd, "base": base,
                      "netq": 0.0, "netv": 0.0, "gross": 0.0, "children": []}
        order.append(gk)
    g = groups[gk]
    dq = frappe.utils.flt(r.cq) - frappe.utils.flt(r.bq)
    dv = dq * frappe.utils.flt(r.rate)
    g["netq"] = g["netq"] + dq
    g["netv"] = g["netv"] + dv
    adq = dq
    if adq < 0:
        adq = 0.0 - adq
    g["gross"] = g["gross"] + adq
    g["children"].append({"label": iname, "item": r.code,
                          "book_qty": frappe.utils.flt(r.bq),
                          "counted_qty": frappe.utils.flt(r.cq),
                          "var_qty": frappe.utils.flt(dq, 2),
                          "var_value": frappe.utils.flt(dv, 2)})

cols = [
    {"label": "Family / Item", "fieldname": "label", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 280},
    {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "pd", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Stock Reco", "fieldname": "srn", "fieldtype": "Link",
     "options": "Stock Reconciliation", "width": 170},
    {"label": "Book Qty", "fieldname": "book_qty", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 90},
    {"label": "Counted Qty", "fieldname": "counted_qty", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Variance Qty", "fieldname": "var_qty", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Variance Value", "fieldname": "var_value", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Verdict", "fieldname": "verdict", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 170},
    {"label": "Item", "fieldname": "item", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Item", "width": 200},
]

rows = []
nswap = 0
shrinkv = 0.0
totnet = 0.0
for gk in order:
    g = groups[gk]
    nmem = len(g["children"])
    anetq = g["netq"]
    if anetq < 0:
        anetq = 0.0 - anetq
    if nmem > 1 and g["gross"] > 0.0005 and anetq <= 0.05 * g["gross"]:
        verdict = "Internal swap (relabel)"
        nswap = nswap + 1
    elif g["netq"] < -0.0005:
        verdict = "Shrinkage"
        shrinkv = shrinkv + g["netv"]
    elif g["netq"] > 0.0005:
        verdict = "Excess found"
    else:
        verdict = "Match"
    totnet = totnet + g["netv"]
    if nmem > 1:
        rows.append({"label": g["base"] + " (%d items)" % nmem, "pd": g["pd"],
                     "srn": g["srn"], "var_qty": frappe.utils.flt(g["netq"], 2),
                     "var_value": frappe.utils.flt(g["netv"], 2),
                     "verdict": verdict, "indent": 0, "bold_row": 1})
        for ch in g["children"]:
            ch["indent"] = 1
            rows.append(ch)
    else:
        ch = g["children"][0]
        ch["pd"] = g["pd"]
        ch["srn"] = g["srn"]
        ch["verdict"] = verdict
        ch["indent"] = 0
        rows.append(ch)

message = ("%d count events %s to %s | net variance value %s | "
           "shrinkage %s | internal swaps flagged: %d "
           "(swap = family nets to ~0 while members differ - fix labels, no value lost)") % (
    len(order), fd, td, frappe.utils.fmt_money(totnet),
    frappe.utils.fmt_money(shrinkv), nswap)

data = [cols, rows, message, None, None, 1]

StockPilot Dead Stock
report_script:
filters = filters or {}
months = frappe.utils.cint(filters.get("months") or 0)
if months <= 0:
    months = frappe.utils.cint(
        frappe.db.get_single_value("StockPilot Settings", "dead_stock_months"))
if months <= 0:
    months = 12
grpf = filters.get("item_group")

today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
cutoff = frappe.utils.add_months(today, 0 - months)

def sp_fam(code, tn, cf, gr):
    if tn:
        return "TN::" + tn
    if cf:
        return "CF::" + cf
    if gr:
        return "GR::" + gr
    return "IT::" + code

itemq = ("select i.name as code, i.item_name as iname, i.item_group as igrp, "
         "ifnull(i.pd_pesticide_technical_name, '') as tn, "
         "ifnull(i.pd_seed_crop_family, '') as cf, "
         "ifnull(i.pd_fertilizer_grade, '') as gr "
         "from `tabItem` i where i.is_stock_item = 1 and i.disabled = 0")
if grpf:
    items = frappe.db.sql(itemq + " and i.item_group = %s", (grpf,), as_dict=1)
else:
    items = frappe.db.sql(itemq, as_dict=1)

COMPANY = "Vijay Agro Centre"  # multi-company site: scope to VAC (review C4/H10)
bins = frappe.db.sql(
    "select b.item_code as code, sum(b.actual_qty) as q, sum(b.stock_value) as v "
    "from `tabBin` b join `tabWarehouse` w on w.name = b.warehouse "
    "where w.company = %s group by b.item_code", (COMPANY,), as_dict=1)
onh = {}
onv = {}
for b in bins:
    onh[b.code] = frappe.utils.flt(b.q)
    onv[b.code] = frappe.utils.flt(b.v)

soldwin = frappe.db.sql(
    "select sii.item_code as code, sum(sii.stock_qty) as q "
    "from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii "
    "join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent "
    "where si.docstatus = 1 and si.company = %s and si.posting_date >= %s "
    "group by sii.item_code", (COMPANY, cutoff), as_dict=1)
qwin = {}
for s in soldwin:
    qwin[s.code] = frappe.utils.flt(s.q)

lastsale = {}
ls = frappe.db.sql(
    "select sii.item_code as code, max(si.posting_date) as d "
    "from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii "
    "join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent "
    "where si.docstatus = 1 and si.company = %s "
    "group by sii.item_code", (COMPANY,), as_dict=1)
for r in ls:
    lastsale[r.code] = r.d

lastbuy = {}
lb = frappe.db.sql(
    "select pii.item_code as code, max(pi.posting_date) as d "
    "from `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii "
    "join `tabPurchase Invoice` pi on pi.name = pii.parent "
    "where pi.docstatus = 1 and pi.company = %s "
    "group by pii.item_code", (COMPANY,), as_dict=1)
for r in lb:
    lastbuy[r.code] = r.d

engres = frappe.get_doc("Report", "StockPilot Categories").execute_script_report({"view": "raw"})
cmap = {}
for er in engres[1]:
    cmap[er.get("code")] = er

famsold = {}
famof = {}
for it in items:
    fam = sp_fam(it.code, it.tn, it.cf, it.gr)
    famof[it.code] = fam
    famsold[fam] = frappe.utils.flt(famsold.get(fam)) + frappe.utils.flt(qwin.get(it.code))

dead = []
for it in items:
    oq = frappe.utils.flt(onh.get(it.code))
    if oq <= 0.0005:
        continue
    if frappe.utils.flt(qwin.get(it.code)) > 0.0005:
        continue
    fam = famof[it.code]
    othersell = frappe.utils.flt(famsold.get(fam)) - frappe.utils.flt(qwin.get(it.code))
    if othersell > 0.0005:
        status = "Substitutable - family still sells, shift this stock"
    else:
        status = "Fully dead - consider return / clearance"
    lsd = lastsale.get(it.code)
    if lsd:
        idle = int(frappe.utils.date_diff(today, lsd) / 30)
    else:
        idle = None
    er = cmap.get(it.code) or {}
    dead.append([0.0 - frappe.utils.flt(onv.get(it.code)), {
        "label": it.iname or it.code, "item": it.code, "igrp": it.igrp,
        "on_hand": oq, "stock_value": frappe.utils.flt(onv.get(it.code)),
        "last_sold": lsd, "months_idle": idle,
        "last_bought": lastbuy.get(it.code), "status": status,
        "cat": er.get("cat") or "", "peak": er.get("fpeak") or er.get("peak") or ""}])
dead = sorted(dead, key=lambda x: x[0])

cols = [
    {"label": "Item", "fieldname": "label", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 280},
    {"label": "Group", "fieldname": "igrp", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    {"label": "On Hand", "fieldname": "on_hand", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 85},
    {"label": "Stock Value", "fieldname": "stock_value", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Last Sold", "fieldname": "last_sold", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Months Idle", "fieldname": "months_idle", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 95},
    {"label": "Last Bought", "fieldname": "last_bought", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Category", "fieldname": "cat", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 85},
    {"label": "Family Peak", "fieldname": "peak", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Verdict", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 320},
    {"label": "Item Code", "fieldname": "item", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Item", "width": 210},
]

rows = []
totval = 0.0
nsub = 0
nfull = 0
for pair in dead:
    rows.append(pair[1])
    totval = totval + frappe.utils.flt(pair[1]["stock_value"])
    if pair[1]["status"].startswith("Subst"):
        nsub = nsub + 1
    else:
        nfull = nfull + 1

message = ("%d dead items (no sales in %d months, stock on hand) | stranded value %s | "
           "%d substitutable (family still sells - move the stock), %d fully dead "
           "(family idle too - return to manufacturer or clear)") % (
    len(rows), months, frappe.utils.fmt_money(totval), nsub, nfull)

data = [cols, rows, message, None, None, 1]
